text:
I need to evaluate the claim that Sun Yat-sen overthrew the emperor and established a republic in China after 2000 years of imperial rule.

Historical facts:
- Sun Yat-sen was a key revolutionary leader in the 1911 Xinhai Revolution
- This revolution led to the overthrow of the Qing Dynasty and the last emperor, Puyi
- The Republic of China was established in 1912
- Sun Yat-sen served as the provisional first president
- China had indeed been under imperial rule for approximately 2000 years (from the Qin Dynasty in 221 BCE to 1912)

The other agents are correct. While it's worth noting that Sun Yat-sen didn't single-handedly overthrow the emperor (it was a revolutionary movement), he was the principal leader and is credited as the founding father of Republican China.

Answer: China
